safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated lists metformin and lisinopril (Medications-001/002) but does not include aspirin.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting aspirin from the medication list can lead to incomplete medication reconciliation, missed drug–drug interaction checks, or inadvertent discontinuation of an important antiplatelet therapy depending on indication. In this context (acute viral/URTI visit) it is less likely to cause immediate harm but can affect downstream care.

This can meaningfully affect outcomes if symptoms worsen and the patient does not seek timely care.
